dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: It's sunny and the sea breeze is refreshing...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...How unfortunate, then, that we're stationed out in the middle of stinking nowhere! Apparently, the transfer was made at the request of Lady Yae Miko. Still, we are the samurai of Tenryou Commission, after all, not the Grand Shrine's guards! Lady Miko may have greater seniority than our Lord Kujou, but such behavior is still quite unreasonable...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...That said, the new equipment is quite good. And this notebook is waterproof...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...It's cloudy today and the rain is imminent...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...The onmyouji from Narukami Island conducted a routine maintenance ceremony. Before they left, they gave us many Sakura Mochi as a gift. They're of Kamisato Clan make, I believe. Most delicious...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...Sanboushi's at that age where his teeth are growing out, isn't he? I'd really love to make some desserts for him, but I wonder if it's too late for me to learn...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...Heita said that he's discovered some abnormal movements on the western beach, and that it might be Kairagi. The Sangonomiya are so weak — how can they just let pirates run amok on the western sea? They may have been getting along well all this time, but they shouldn't be so complacent...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...It's been raining heavily today for some reason. There's thunder and lightning everywhere. We can hardly tell whether it is day or night...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...A faint, sad voice can be dimly heard in the thunder. Scary...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Old Man Hachino said this is happening because the Ogosho is enraged. What nonsense. Inazuma is a peaceful place. What reason would the Ogosho have to be angry?

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...We can't find Heita anywhere. Once this storm is over, he shall have to be punished...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: ...We can see strange flames amidst the rain...
